item.title: Unit 2 Reflection
item.description:
Unit 2 Reflection – The Nature of Information Problems

In Unit 2,  learning became more practical and easy as compared to Unit 1. Unit 2 is typically learning how information is actually processed and used. This unit involved more technical and practical concepts. From this unit, I realised that working with information involves many challenges such as understanding the problem clearly, choosing the right representation, and mainly interpreting the results correctly.

item.title: My First Blog
item.description:
My Learning Experience

Unit 1 Reflection – Understanding What Information Truly Means

In my introductory class, I initially thought that learning this course would be simple, since it involves studying the basics of information, data, technology, and tools related to information systems. However, after a week of classes, I realised that information is actually a deeper concept. Information looks simple at first, but it becomes complicated when we try to define it clearly or when I try to work with it in practice.

Welcome to My First Blog

Introduction

Hello, my name is Manoj Bhajantri. I am currently a student at Azim Premji University (APU), Bangalore, pursuing a B.Sc(Honours) Information Science. I have a strong interest in learning new technologies and developing my academic and practical skills. I am motivated to grow professionally and actively engage in my studies to build a strong foundation for my future career.
